description: Stop sending one form's answers to a provider. Reversible — the configuration is dropped but the connected account stays, and fillo_enable_integration can start it again. Already-delivered rows are not recalled. Responses Fillo holds keep accumulating in the responses grid. Needs integrations:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

provider.description: Which destination: google_sheets, notion, slack, hubspot, or discord.

name: fillo_disable_integration
title: Stop a form's destination
